- Appears when speech actually starts, stays prominent for 4–6 seconds, then collapses to a subtle indicator until playback ends. [...] User: keep the modal open for a few seconds after playback ends in case I want to jump back to relisten

Assistant: Yes. I’ll make the completed state linger briefly—about eight seconds—with the transcript and timeline still active. During that grace period, clicking a word or scrubbing backward should start a replay from that approximate point, rather than leaving a dead card on screen. [...] Assistant: The relisten path is now implemented: completed items linger for eight seconds, retain transcript/time/duration, and word clicks or timeline scrubs enqueue replay at the selected offset. A newly starting item cancels the linger immediately. Compilation is running. [...] User: after playback is done and the modal will close after a few seconds, can we make an animation fading it out? that'd be cool, obviously pause the countdown if I hover and remove it if I start playback again or something

Assistant: Yes. I’ll make the linger lifecycle feel intentional:

- Eight-second grace period after playback.
- Hover pauses the remaining countdown.
- Leaving resumes from the remaining time, not a fresh eight seconds.
- Expiry fades the HUD out before removal. [...] - Starting/restarting playback cancels both countdown and fade immediately and restores full opacity. [...] Assistant: The amended implementation is now local: exact remaining-time pause/resume, a cancellable 340ms fade, full-opacity restoration on hover/replay, and immediate cancellation when new speech begins. Tests are running before the PR head is updated.
